project_title: NAFAMITRA — MSME Business Operating System & AI Voice Assistant
app_archetype: Modern Indian Fintech (PhonePe / Paytm / Khatabook Aesthetic)

core_principles: Speed & High Readability: Indian shopkeepers need split-second clarity while multi-tasking behind counters.
Thumb-Zone Priority: Crucial actions (Scan QR, New Bill, Voice Mic, Udhaar entry) are within single-thumb reach.
Color-Coded Trust Economy: Instant recognition — Green (Income/Money In), Red (Udhaar/Expense/Money Out), Yellow (Pending/Discounts), Blue (Info/Inventory), Purple (AI Intelligence/Voice).
Tactile Cards Over Dense Tables: Card-based rows with big touch targets, avatar initials, high-contrast badges, and quick swipe/tap actions.
Continuous AI Voice Presence: Floating voice assistant widget with status animations on all screens for hands-free operation.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for currency, GST, total amounts, invoice IDs)

colors.theme: Light theme default with optional dark mode toggle

primary_brand.description: Represents Sales, Profits, Positive Balance, Customer Add, Cash Collection

udhaar_expense_red.label: Udhaar Given / You Will Get / Expense / Out of Stock

positive_green.label: Payment Received / Cash Collected / Profit / In Stock

warning_amber.label: Discount / Low Stock Alert / Udhaar Reminder Due

ai_voice_purple.label: AI Voice Assistant / Business Copilot / Smart Insights

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

voice_assistant_widget.style: Floating circular 56px action button with glowing purple-indigo ring and microphone icon

states.idle: bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform
states.listening: bg-red-500 text-white animate-pulse ring-4 ring-red-300 shadow-xl

voice_assistant_widget.voice_modal: Full overlay or bottom sheet with wave visualizer, live Hindi/English transcription, and quick suggested command chips (e.g., 'Ramesh ko 500 ka udhaar add karo', 'Aaj ki total sale batao', 'Samosa ka stock update karo')

key_features_and_pages.name: Auth & Business Setup
key_features_and_pages.details: Mobile OTP / Password login, Business Name, Store Category (Kirana, Apparel, Pharmacy, Electronics), GSTIN option, Hinglish toggle.

key_features_and_pages.name: Main Dashboard
key_features_and_pages.details: Daily Sales Metric Cards, Today's Profit, Udhaar Outstanding, Quick Action Grid (Scan QR, New Bill, Add Udhaar, Add Stock), AI Insight Chips, Sales Chart.

key_features_and_pages.name: POS & Express Billing
key_features_and_pages.details: Fast item search, barcode scan simulator, quick quantity increment (+/-), custom discount, customer attachment, cash/UPI/Udhaar payment mode, print/WhatsApp bill.

key_features_and_pages.name: Customer Management & QR
key_features_and_pages.details: Customer contact list, Udhaar status badges, individual profile with transaction ledger, generate custom Customer Digital Loyalty QR Card.

key_features_and_pages.name: Product Catalogue & Inventory
key_features_and_pages.details: Item name, category, buy price, sell price, stock counter, low-stock threshold warning badge, quick stock refill modal.

key_features_and_pages.name: Udhaar / Credit Ledger
key_features_and_pages.details: Gave (You Gave Udhaar - Red) vs Got (Customer Paid - Green), send WhatsApp payment reminder button, auto interest calculator.

key_features_and_pages.name: Supplier Management
key_features_and_pages.details: Vendor directory, purchase orders, payable balance tracking, order re-stock flow.

key_features_and_pages.name: Loyalty & Rewards
key_features_and_pages.details: Points per purchase setup, reward tiers, redeem discount points at POS, customer loyalty rank.

key_features_and_pages.name: Marketing & WhatsApp Campaigns
key_features_and_pages.details: Pre-made festival promo templates (Diwali, Eid, Holi, Sunday Sale), broadcast WhatsApp message simulator, promotional banner maker.

key_features_and_pages.name: Reports & Analytics
key_features_and_pages.details: Daily/Weekly/Monthly Revenue graphs, Profit Margin reports, Top Selling Products, Tax/GST summary download.

key_features_and_pages.name: AI Voice Assistant Dedicated Page
key_features_and_pages.details: Full conversational screen with mic waveform animation, voice command log history, sample commands in English & Hindi.

key_features_and_pages.name: AI Business Chat Copilot
key_features_and_pages.details: Conversational assistant for 'Which product gives highest margin?', 'How to grow sales this week?', 'Draft reminder message'.

key_features_and_pages.name: Settings & Staff Access
key_features_and_pages.details: Store Profile, Staff Permissions (Cashier vs Manager), Print Receipt layout setup, Subscription Plan status.

key_features_and_pages.name: Admin Panel (SaaS Management)
key_features_and_pages.details: Multi-tenant tenant list, total registered shopkeepers, active subscriptions, revenue metrics, global system alerts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow testid conventions strictly: all buttons, links, inputs, metrics, tables, and tabs MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='pos-create-bill-button', data-testid='voice-assistant-mic-button', data-testid='udhaar-add-entry-button').
Use Lucide-react icons for clear, crisp UI navigation (ShoppingCart, Users, CreditCard, Sparkles, Mic, FileText, Settings, LayoutDashboard, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, MessageSquare).
Ensure the floating mic button is visible on every view (via a global layout wrapper) and opens either a Voice Modal or triggers listening mode.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions like 'Bill Created Successfully', 'Udhaar Saved', 'WhatsApp Reminder Sent', 'Voice Command Processed'.
Avoid standard table over-crowding; use clean cards with clear status pills and monetary badges for mobile responsiveness.
Ensure dark mode toggle works smoothly across all 14 views.
Integrate mock AI voice recognition with realistic voice processing simulation and immediate UI response.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_dropdowns: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for header, navigation dropdowns, popovers, or modals. Always set explicit high-opacity solid or glass background with borders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous padding (p-4 to p-6 for cards, gap-4 to gap-6 for grids).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.animations: Add subtle motion for voice waves, hover states on cards, button tap responses, and tab transitions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.typography: Never use Inter for primary titles; use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans with font-mono for numbers.
